source_refs.note: Formula: a main subheading of 22.2.5 Range, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 195-196.

items: Xₘₐₓ = maximum value in the data set.
Xₘᵢₙ = minimum value in the data set.

blocks.title: Steps to calculate the Range with example
blocks.problem: Consider a dataset representing the ages of a group of people: 25, 20, 22, 30, 42, 45, 50.
steps: Step 1: Arrange the data in ascending order.
Step 2: Identify the greatest value in the dataset.
Step 3: Identify the smallest value in the dataset.
Step 4: Subtract the maximum value from the minimum value to calculate the range.
book_errors: Subtract the maximum value from the minimum value

blocks.text: Step 4 should say: subtract the minimum value from the maximum value (Xₘₐₓ − Xₘᵢₙ), as the formula and the book's own working (50 − 20 = 30) do.
